name: Message to Maxwell
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I'm a goblin of my word, friend. Now listen closely:

These orcs are used primarily as beasts of burden and cannon fodder for the black dragonflight!

Their true leader is none other than Nefarian, brood of Deathwing. I've also discovered the location of Nefarian's subordinates in this part of the citadel.

Take this map to Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes. It has the location of these fiends marked for easy identification.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This coincides with much of what we already knew. Regardless, it is interesting and rather unfortunate information.

The markings on this map will prove valuable in thinning the Blackrock menace.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, adventurer. It has been a long time.
